title: dracaena pfennigii
intro: Dracaena pfennigii, commonly known as the Dragon Tree, is a species of flowering plant native to tropical Africa. It is known for its health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, improving air quality by removing pollutants, and promoting a good night's sleep. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of Dracaena pfennigii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
